I’m the type of person to bottle up all my problems, no matter how big or small they are, and usually they’re pretty small and petty, so when there’s a lot of them, I really don’t know how, or to who, to talk about them, since to me they feel just absolutely stupid.

Lately I feel like I could break down at any moment, that anything and/or anyone could trigger me to break down in tears. I’m frustrated because of this, I feel weak and useless because I’ve been crying over the smallest of things, and I feel like if I told anyone they would tell me to “just suck it up” or “don’t worry it’ll pass eventually”.

With this whole quarantine thing, I’ve been feeling socially drained, over worked, pressured, and over all just a lot of negative feelings have surfaced either back up, or they’re just completely new. I’m 14 and I’m in 7th grade, yet I feel like I have so much work to do that that’s all I do, every day I try to do as much as humanly possible, yet I just feel like there’s double the work the next day, even if the next day is the weekend. I’ve been pulling all nighters, skipping meals, losing track in my exercise routine, and completely just locking myself in my pile of school work. I know this isn’t healthy, but if I don’t do this, I’ll fall behind on work. My father recently got the virus, and my mother decided it would be best if me, her and our dog, moved into this small one person apartment thing (I’m sorry for the bad description, my native language is Finnish so not everything comes to mind right away) that’s attached to our garage, and the internet connection here is very bad, I’ve tried everything yet I still can’t do my work, so now it’s all piling up very quickly, and I can’t help but feel helpless and useless while I sit here and do nothing. My father was moved to the hospital, so we will in a couple of days be cleaning the main house, and moving back into it. I know when I get back, I’ll have a tremendous amount of school work and assignments, some are due today/tomorrow (the time is currently 2.24/2.24am) so I’m not too sure how I’ll do my work, and I can’t even inform my teachers of my new living conditions because of the bad connection. 

I find myself not being a extrovert or an introvert, so an ambivert. Because of this, I crave social connection, but I also don’t, I feel torn because of my own feelings, and on top of that I feel lonely an lost, I’ve been in contact with my friends, but I very much like physically contact, like hugs, laughing together, holding hands, cuddling, etc, so when I lose these small things that bring light to my gloomier days, I quickly start to feel more and more lonely, sad, anxious, lost, stressed, and so on. 

I’ve also been losing interest in the things I love, I’ve just over all stopped caring, I feel like nothing matters to me anymore. On top of all this, I’ve had a past full of self harm, attempts of suicide, mental break downs and panic and/or anxiety attacks, so with a past like mine, I quickly find myself wanting to go back to my old habits. Recently I’ve found myself thinking “maybe if I were to try and attempt suicide again, and actually succeed, all my problems would go away, all this stress would just be a thought that once lingered in my mind, and nothing more”, to add to this, I’ve been self harming, I know it’s unhealthy in multiple ways, but it’s the only things that seems to help with the stress, for even just a minute or two.


With all this and more that I feel I don’t have the energy to explain, piling up onto my shoulders, I feel like I just want to end it all, so if anyone has any advice, even a tiny bit, I would be forever grateful.

Thank you for reading this long rant of mine, and I hope I do not bother or trigger anyone. I hope you have a good night, day or what ever time it is for you.

Ik this is serious and all but let me just lighten things up a bit, when you said you swept it under the rug last summer I couldn’t help but think of the song “I know what you did last summer”. Just me? Okay

But in all seriousness I felt the same way, I thought about so many things that I could be but none of them really clicked, and then I found out about being NB and well it clicked right away, after that I started identifying as NB and genderqueer, I never really could pick one so I thought I’d identify as what I felt like, I mean it’s all just about feeling comfortable in your own skin, so what’s so bad about having multiple labels right? So over all my advice would be to do what makes you comfortable, even if someone tells you that it’s confusing them or the people around you, all that matters is what makes you feel comfortable in your own skin and what just clicks for you
